name: unreal-codex-bridge
description: Cross-platform bridge connecting OpenAI Codex to Unreal Engine 5.8 via native Model Context Protocol.

interface.shortDescription: Connect OpenAI Codex to Unreal Engine 5.8 editor via native MCP
interface.longDescription: Inspect scenes, query project intelligence, analyze asset dependencies and circular references, parse Blueprint graph S-expressions, author gameplay, and execute Play-In-Editor tests across Windows and macOS.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Unreal project and summarize active level assets.
Check asset dependencies and circular references for the player character.
Build a small game where the player collects five stars to unlock a gate and test it in PIE.
